Name: Seed
Label: Noise Seed
Description: Selects the deterministic pattern used by the noise generator.
Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible noise layout.

Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Label: Noise Algorithm
Description: Selects the noise family used for every noise octave.

Name: Frequency
Label: Noise Scale
Description: Controls the size of the shared noise features.
Tooltip: Higher values create smaller, more closely spaced features.

Name: Lacunarity
Label: Noise Lacunarity
Description: Sets the frequency multiplier between successive noise layers.
Tooltip: Higher values make each octave add finer detail more quickly.

Name: Persistence
Label: Noise Persistence
Description: Sets how much amplitude each successive noise layer retains.
Tooltip: Higher values keep more high-frequency detail.

Name: NoiseOctaves
Label: Noise Octaves
Description: Controls how many layers are evaluated.
Tooltip: More layers add detail and increase generation cost.

Name: NoiseWarp
Label: Noise Warp
Description: Bends the sampling domain before evaluating the noise.
Tooltip: Increase it to break up smooth, predictable terrain contours.

Name: NoiseJitter
Label: Noise Jitter
Description: Moves feature points inside cellular noise cells.
Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley noise.

Name: Offset
Label: Sampling Offset
Description: Offsets the noise sampling position in 3D space.
Tooltip: Move through the noise field without changing its scale.
